scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proof_status: Complete analytic argument with signed-chain facet and Dilworth inputs, plus finite exact-rational spot checks.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.statement: A universal sharp lower bound, exact John roundness criterion, and layered equality cases. Arbitrary-poset John semiaxes are not classified. Euclidean coordinate metric is essential. Prior graph-entropy inequalities may imply some aspects by a different formulation; worldwide priority is not certified.

title: A sharp entropy bound for John ellipsoids of enriched chain polytopes
